1 غَهِبَ , [aor.
غَهَبَ ,] inf. n. غَهَبٌ, He was unmindful, negligent, inattentive, inadvertent, inconsiderate, or heedless. (S.) You say, غَهِبَ عَنْهُ He was unmindful, &c., and forgetful, of him, or it; (K, TA;) as also ↓ اغهب . (TA.) And أَصَابَ صَيْدًا غَهَبًا He hit an object of the chase, or objects thereof, inadvertently, unintentionally. (A 'Obeyd, S, K, from a trad.) ―
-b2- And غَهِبَهُ He was ignorant of it; as also عَهِبَهُ. (TA in art. عهب.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
